title: Lexical map stitcher + template compatibility adapter for model onboarding
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: New model variants have subtle differences in subword boundaries and delimiter escape behavior that cause chat templates to generate misaligned role tokens (e.g., assistant prompts that split role markers across subtokens). This results in skewed token counts, degraded prefix caching efficacy, and occasional structured-output failures when publishing performance profiles and pinning versions.

Goal: Build a lightweight 'lexical map stitcher' that reconciles model tokenizer outputs to our canonical chat-template token model at onboarding time, and a compatibility adapter that makes temporary template adjustments for models that cannot be remapped losslessly. The feature must be safe for automated profile publishing and version pinning and include regression gates (token-count drift, structured-output tests, and prefix-cache hit rate thresholds).

Acceptance criteria:
- Onboarding flow automatically computes a lexical mapping table for the new model and stores it in the model profile.
- For mappings that are lossy, the adapter can syntactically alter chat templates (delimiter escapes or role-marker expansion) with an explainable diff that is logged and surfaced in the onboarding UI.
- Publishing a performance profile is blocked if token-count drift > 12% on the canonical eval prompt set, or if structured-output tests fail on 3/50 golden prompts.
- Canary rollout hooks exist: first 2% of live traffic uses pinned model+adapter; telemetry for token counts, prefix cache hit rate, generation latency, and downstream eval score are recorded and plotted in the Console.
- Automated rollback path available when latency regression > 30ms p50 or cache hits fall by > 10%.

Constraints & non-goals:
- We will not replace tokenizer internals nor attempt to re-tokenize user inputs at runtime; this is a mapping/sanitization layer run during onboarding and optional lightweight template transformations.
- No KMS/security-dependent changes required for this ticket.

Design summary:
1) Lexical map stitcher: sample representative prompts (dev/golden + random customer-like prompts) through the model tokenizer. Create a mapping of canonical token boundaries -> model subtokens using a greedy aligner that respects byte offsets. Record conflict types (split at whitespace, punctuation, multi-byte boundaries) and score per-rule safety. Persist mapping as a small rule list (not a full-tokenizer).
2) Compatibility adapter: when stitcher flags lossy cases, synthesize minimal template edits (e.g., add explicit space between role delimiter and role name, introduce escaping marker, or prefer long-form role markers) that restore alignment. Each edit has a confidence score and a human-readable rationale.
3) Profile publishing gating: integrate token-drift and structured-output checks into the onboarding pipeline. If gated, mark profile as "needs-review" and attach diff; allow PM/Design to approve minor template edits.
4) Model catalog changes: store mapping metadata and adapter diff under model profile, and include a flag for 'auto-applied adapter for runtime' for Dedicated/Private deployments.

Testing & QA:
- Unit tests for aligner heuristics with edge cases: combining marks, zero-width joiners, surrogate pairs.
- Integration tests with runtime batcher to ensure prefix cache hit rate isn't regressed on synthetic traffic.
- Golden prompt regression suite (50 prompts) for structured-output and role delimiter correctness.
- Fuzz tests that mutate whitespace and punctuation to detect brittle rules.

Rollout plan:
- Phase 1 (internal): enable for onboarding test models, publish telemetry to an internal dashboard.
- Phase 2 (canary): enable auto-apply adapter on 2% of traffic for new pinning operations; observe metrics for 48 hours.
- Phase 3 (gradual): expand to 30% then full by model-owner approval.

Rollback: disable adapter at model-catalog level and revert to previous pinned variant. Document rollback in audit log with attached telemetry snapshot.
implementation_notes: Add tokenizer sampling harness in onboarding service (safe, limited-memory sampling).
Implement greedy byte-offset aligner with conflict classification (lossless, lossy, ambiguous).
Create adapter diff format (textual, displayable) and storage schema in model profile metadata.
Add gating step in profile-publish pipeline with token-drift and structured-output checks.
Expose canary toggle and telemetry dashboards in Console (token-count histogram, cache hits, latency).
